newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman ups Hewlett-Packard.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman ups Hewlett-Packard.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs analyst Laura Conigliaro said she put Hewlett-Packard Co on the brokerage's recommended list and raised her fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $3.25 per share from $3.00 after the company reported first quarter earnings.
-- Conigliaro previously rated the stock as outperform.
-- She said the company reported what she termed "a very strange quarter."
-- "You don't usually look favorably on a company that is light on revenues and light on the order side," Conigliaro said in a telephone interview. "They made the quarter on gross margin."
-- However, she said the high degree of negative sentiment on the stock moved her to make the upgrade.
-- She said Hewlett faces easier year-to-year comparisons in the second half of 1997, when it should also benefit from new product introductions.
